crossRefs.note: The fear of Yahweh is the beginning of knowledge; but the foolish despise wisdom and instruction.
The fear of Yahweh is to hate evil. I hate pride, arrogance, the evil way, and the perverse mouth.
To man he said, ‘Behold, the fear of the Lord, that is wisdom. To depart from evil is understanding.’ ”

translations.web: The fear of Yahweh teaches wisdom. Before honor is humility.
translations.bsb: The fear of the LORD is the instruction of wisdom, and humility comes before honor.
translations.kjv: The fear of the LORD is the instruction of wisdom; and before honour is humility.
translations.asv: The fear of Jehovah is the instruction of wisdom; And before honor goeth humility.
